status: User-approved original references retained unchanged; editable SVG artwork and animation implemented in internal EnginePreview. See docs/color-unlock-plan.md and docs/device-support.md for scope and acceptance.
layout: Each sheet: two/three bottles by closed/opening pose. Key-based group condition illustrated; appearance may also represent the existing color-full condition.

Use case: stylized-concept / ui-mockup. Create one refined LANDSCAPE 1536x1024 Bottle Harmony grouped-cover concept sheet. Supplied image is an approved STYLE REFERENCE only, not an edit target. Retain its dark charcoal-blue atmosphere, cool thin cyan-gray glass highlights, restrained champagne-gold hardware and stylized mobile puzzle material finish. No phone UI. No cloth. A clean two-by-two matrix: columns exact Chinese labels "关闭" and "展开示意"; rows labels "双瓶" and "三瓶". Upper row groups contain EXACTLY TWO BOTTLES each; lower row groups EXACTLY THREE BOTTLES each. Both rows use the SAME FULL-SIZE classic glass bottle silhouette and height, identical bottle spacing and column pitch. A triple group is 1.5 times the width of a double group; DO NOT shrink three bottles to fit equal widths. All groups are straight frontal views, bases aligned within row, readable generous negative space.

Each group is ONE connected shared enclosure with exactly two or three clearly countable bottle bays, a continuous top rail and shallow base. It must read as a joined group, not separate boxes placed together. ONE small central champagne-gold keyhole clasp per group on the shared top rail, not a separate lock per bottle or door. Small bottom legend "同一把钥匙 · 整组开放". All closed bays fully opaque on front, sides and top, no liquid/color/fill-level visible through seams. All opened bays reveal the original full-size glass bottles, unmoved and unshrunk. In every opened group bottle1 top-to-bottom coral / jade / yellow / coral; bottle2 jade / yellow / coral / jade; bottle3 when present yellow / coral / jade / yellow. Each has four equal liquid portions below the shoulder, reference glass unchanged; preserve these same per-bottle stacks wherever repeated. No extra bottles, treasures, inventory, reward particles, switches, coins or independent unlock actions. This is an OPENING POSE illustration, not the finished board; bottom quiet caption "过程示意 · 开放结束后撤去外壳". Covers remain inside original slot envelope; no giant doors spreading into adjacent bottle space. 
Title exact "联格薄木匣 · 双瓶与三瓶".
Material and construction: elegant thin dark walnut case with warm subtle grain, narrow beveled edges, softened rectangular outline and gently rounded upper corners, not a coffin, cabinet furniture or treasure chest. Front is two or three vertically divided opaque panels corresponding exactly to the bottle bays. Shared restrained wood top and bottom rails show the connection. One central GOLD KEYHOLE latch connects to a subtle horizontal release bar shared by all panels; it clearly unlocks the entire group. Closed exterior is compact, no thick walls, oversized hinges or rivets.
Opening column: EACH panel opens synchronously a modest 15-20 degrees and retracts beside its own divider, showing all two / three complete bottle silhouettes through the group. Thin door leaves seen edge-on, no large wings stretching outward. Same scale as closed group. Hardware is small, quiet and premium-looking. The original glass/liquid colors dominate once revealed. Warm wood pairs comfortably with cool glass. Typography legible and exact; title and short labels only.
